title: Logo and colours
subtitle: Your business’s logo and colours — on every document, on price tags and in listings. The preview shows the letterhead as it prints.
loadError: The logo and colours could not be loaded.

logo.title: Logo
logo.formatHint: SVG preferred, PNG at least 600 px on the long edge. JPEG is not accepted: it has no transparency and prints with a grey box.

kindHints.primary: Required. The other variants use it until they have a file of their own.
kindHints.mono_dark: For a colour letterhead on white paper. Without a file of its own, the primary logo is used.
kindHints.favicon: The small icon in the website’s browser tab. Without a file of its own, the primary logo is used.

logo.failed: The logo could not be saved.

colours.title: Colours
colours.primaryHint: Your business’s colour on documents, e.g. behind the logo mark.
colours.secondaryHint: A second colour for accents. Leave it empty if your business has none.
colours.explanation: Text on documents needs enough contrast to be readable: at least 4.5 : 1 under WCAG AA. A light primary colour — yellow, say — makes white text on it unreadable on every document.
colours.savedWithWarning: Saved. At least one colour pair falls short of 4.5 : 1 — text on it is hard to read on documents.
